interface.longDescription: Hutchrok service procedures and source-linked Hutchrok OS review workflows. Prepare filing drafts, business plans, signal triage, approval packets, engineering findings, and plugin releases with evidence and human review. Skills-only: no live OS, government, or financial connector is included. Texas SOSPortal navigation, filing preparation, corrections and entity-specific VVL waiver review use available secure host browser tools and existing human approval gates. Claude skills share the repository source. Separate Texas Comptroller eSystems/Webfile procedures cover veteran qualification, report-year obligations and report corrections. SAM.gov and SBA SDVOSB contracting workflows use Hutchrok’s documented real entity identity, secure host authentication, evidence-based certification checks and mandatory procurement readiness review.
